subject: Invoice creation & delivery: portal opt-in vs emailed signed PDFs (Nexon Health)
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nexon — how do they want invoices delivered?

Hi team,

Spoke with Nexon Health procurement this morning (intro with Marie). They need us to confirm who will *create* and *send* the invoice and whether we can push invoices to their vendor portal or if they require emailed signed PDFs to their AP inbox.

Quick context: they have a PO for July (PO# 4478) and are asking for a VAT-friendly invoice that shows our VAT ID and a remit-to address for their EU entity. Procurement mentioned their portal onboarding is available but procurement firewall has delayed SFTP credentials for third parties.

Attached is the invoice sample they asked us to review before sending (invoice_sample_stub.pdf).

Can we:
- Confirm whether we can produce a signed PDF that meets their template and send to ap@nxhealth.eu as a one-off?
- Start portal onboarding in parallel (what do they need from us today to begin)?

Cc'ing Kimberly for billing authority and Connor for portal onboarding. I'll coordinate with Nexon if we go the temporary email route.

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Lead, EMEA | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
+44 20 5555 1212
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nexon — how do they want invoices delivered?

Thanks, Mateo — good summary. From billing side we have two workable paths:

1) Portal (preferred long-term)
   - Requirements: vendor legal name, VAT/Tax ID, remit-to address, contact person + email, example invoice mapping (which fields map to their PO/GL).
   - Technical: they support both API push and SFTP drop. Onboarding typically 2–3 weeks (varies by procurement). We need Connor to request vendor-provisioning and supply a certificate or SFTP public key.

2) Emailed signed PDF (short-term bridge)
   - We can generate a PDF that includes our VAT ID and the PO reference. Procurement often insists on a visible signature block or a signed PDF. We usually supply via signed PDF and set 'ap@' as the sender.

For immediate next steps I need:
- Final remit-to address (legal entity name) from Nexon.
- VAT ID for their reverse-charge handling (if applicable) — otherwise we include our standard VAT line.
- Confirmation whether AP requires a wet signature or a DocuSign-signed PDF is acceptable.

If they accept DocuSign, we can send that today and mark July invoice as 'temporary emailed delivery' while Connor kicks off portal onboarding. If portal onboarding will take >10 business days, let's do the one-off PDF.

Connor: can you confirm the provisioning ETA if we submit vendor request today?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Marie Dubois <ap@nxhealth.eu>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 08:22:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Nexon — how do they want invoices delivered?

Hello Mateo / Kimberly / Connor,

Thanks for the quick follow-up. We can do a portal pilot but procurement has a backlog and the vendor provisioning team may not complete the setup until August. For this month's payment window we need a signed PDF invoice delivered to ap@nxhealth.eu so our AP team can attach it to PO# 4478 and release payment.

Please include the following on the invoice:
- Our PO number: 4478
- Nexon Health EU VAT: FR-12 345678901
- Remit-to: Redwood Inference Ltd, 22 King Street, London, UK, EC3N 4AB
- Billing contact (for confirmation): Marie Dubois <ap@nxhealth.eu>

DocuSign is fine — we accept electronically signed PDFs. I attached the PO for reference (NXH_PO_4478.pdf).

If you can send the signed PDF by end of day Friday (17 Jul) we'll get payment processed in the next AP cycle. After that, please open the portal onboarding request and we can move to API/SFTP in August.

Best regards,
Marie Dubois
